disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorder; all males aged 5.1–14.0 years; clinical cohort to which normative models of between-network rsFC were applied
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Using neuroimaging data from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), we modeled normative trajectories of between-network resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) in non-ASD males across childhood (n = 321). These normative charts were then applied to ASD males (n = 418)"

dataset-of-origin.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II collections of the ABIDE initiative (https://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Data for the current study were from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) I and ABIDE II collections of the ABIDE initiative, publicly available at http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/abide/."

age.detail: From Table 1, Testing (ASD) N = 418; mean and SD as reported
age.supporting_text: "Testing (ASD) N = 418 ... Age at scan (years) ... Mean (± SD) ... 10.4 (± 2.1) ... Range ... 5.1 - 14.0"

sex.detail: Study included exclusively males; no females in the ASD clinical cohort. Female N estimated as 0 by subtraction from total N = 418.
sex.supporting_text: "We focused exclusively on males due to the increased prevalence of ASD in males (Werling and Geschwind, 2013) ... only males between ages 5.1 -14.0 years were included in this study (n = 816)"
